rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when an action, movement, or process stops.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 tai2 zyu6 coeng4 jyu5 ting4 zo2

rows.note: Use this when someone no longer does an activity, especially in everyday speech.

example.english: They cease smoking after the doctor warns them.
example.traditional: 醫生警告過佢哋之後，佢哋就唔再食煙喇。
example.jyutping: ji1 sang1 ging2 gou3 gwo3 keoi5 dei6 zi1 hau6 keoi5 dei6 zau6 m4 zoi3 sik6 jin1 laa3

rows.note: Use this formal option in writing, announcements, or explicit descriptions of an action or process stopping.

example.english: The organizers announced that ticket distribution would cease.
example.traditional: 大會宣布停止派發門票。
example.jyutping: daai6 wui6 syun1 bou3 ting4 zi2 paai3 faat3 mun4 piu3
